corrections.prior: Individuals of one species in an area and time with a realistic opportunity to reproduce.
corrections.corrected: A defined group of organisms of one species in a stated place and time; its boundary includes the individuals being counted or studied.

corrections.prior: Having two different alleles at a locus in a diploid cell or organism.
corrections.corrected: An individual or cell carrying two different alleles at a locus in the diploid model.

corrections.prior: The requirement that all mutually exclusive categories covering a whole population or gene pool add to one.
corrections.corrected: The frequencies of mutually exclusive categories that together cover the whole population or gene pool must add to one.

corrections.prior: A change in DNA sequence that can create a new allele when inherited.
corrections.corrected: A change in DNA sequence that can create a new allele; its contribution to a breeding gene pool depends on transmission through reproduction.
